name: @xiezuomanju/desktop
description: Tauri 2 desktop shell for AI 商业写作台 (loads Vite web app)

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('[desktop] skip: run pnpm build:desktop after Rust+CLI install'); process.exit(0)"
scripts.typecheck: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='src-tauri/tauri.conf.json'; if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('[desktop] missing',p); process.exit(1)} console.log('[desktop] tauri.conf ok');"
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const need=['src-tauri/tauri.conf.json','src-tauri/Cargo.toml']; for (const p of need){ if(!fs.existsSync(p)){ console.error('[desktop] missing',p); process.exit(1)} } console.log('[desktop] shell resources ok');"
